01

Selected work

Six projects. Connected questions.

6 projects

01 / Human–AI collaboration

Parallax

Keeping people and agents on the same page.

I designed how Parallax uses a researcher’s PDF annotations and graph selections to inform the agent’s next response.

Read case study

First author · In submission to CHI 2027

02 / HCI · LLM evaluation

From Prediction to Execution

A plausible prediction is only the beginning.

I designed a benchmark to test when six LLMs can choose the right predictive model for an HCI task and when they can produce a specification that runs.

Read case study

First author · In submission to CHI 2027

03 / Human–AI interaction · Creativity support

EnactiveCanvas

Thinking with AI beyond the chat window.

I helped design the frontend and backend so that selecting or moving notes on the canvas gives the AI context for its next response.

Read case study

System design · In submission to CHI 2027

04 / Multi-agent systems

VirT-Lab

A testbed for exploring how teams coordinate.

I built the backend that schedules agent actions and keeps simulated teams in sync as they move and communicate.

Read case study

2025 · Collaborative research · UIST demo

05 / NLP · Trustworthy AI

Hidden-in-Plain-Text

Testing the boundary between evidence and instruction.

With Ziqi Wei, I developed a benchmark to test whether instructions embedded in retrieved web content change an AI system’s answer.

Read case study

First author · WWW 2026

06 / HCI · Privacy & user agency

ConsentDiff at Scale

Connecting what a site promises to what people can do.

I designed a monthly audit that compares what a site’s privacy policy promises with the choices its consent banner offers.

Read case study

Sole author · CHI EA 2026
